name: Hallux Valgus
definition: Lateral deviation of the great toe with medial prominence of the first metatarsal head, causing variable pain and footwear difficulty.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing radiographs quantify deformity when surgical planning is considered.
investigations.radiographs: AP/lateral weight-bearing foot radiographs are standard for planning.

amber: Surgery is considered for persistent symptomatic deformity, not cosmetic appearance alone.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli deformity phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Lateral deviation of the great toe with medial prominence of the first metatarsal head, causing variable pain and footwear difficulty.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
